facts.text: Evan encourages Sam to continue making small changes for their health journeys.

evidence.quote: I'm here for you, Sam. Let's continue supporting each other on our health journeys.
Yeah, you're right. It takes time, but I'm up for keep trying and making those tiny changes.
C'mon, keep it up! Every little bit counts, you'll get there!

facts.text: Sam acknowledges Evan's support and expresses appreciation for his encouragement.

evidence.quote: Thanks, Evan! I appreciate your support, it means a lot to me to have you in my corner.

Hey Evan, thanks! Appreciate it. I'll definitely keep you posted.
